CREATE TABLE dhmis_control.auth_rate_limits (
	key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	until BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key)
)
tenant:
CREATE TABLE tenant.staff_invites (
	email VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	location_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	used BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.auth_challenges (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	used BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES tenant.staff_users (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.fee_versions (
	service_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36), 
	provider_id VARCHAR(36), 
	fee_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	effective_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (fee_cents >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(service_id) REFERENCES tenant.services (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(provider_id) REFERENCES tenant.staff_users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.staff_sessions (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	expires BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	last_active BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	revoked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES tenant.staff_users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.guardian_links (
	guardian_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	dependent_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	relationship VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(guardian_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(dependent_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.insurance_plans (
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	payer_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	member_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	coverage_pct INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	maximum_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	used_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	waiting_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (coverage_pct >= 0 AND coverage_pct <= 100), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.encounters (
	appointment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	provider_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	soap JSON NOT NULL, 
	procedures JSON NOT NULL, 
	invoice_id VARCHAR(36), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (appointment_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(appointment_id) REFERENCES tenant.appointments (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(provider_id) REFERENCES tenant.staff_users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(invoice_id) REFERENCES tenant.invoices (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.payment_plans (
	invoice_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	installments JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (invoice_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(invoice_id) REFERENCES tenant.invoices (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.treatment_plans (
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	options JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	accepted_option INTEGER, 
	consent_id VARCHAR(36), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES tenant.patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(consent_id) REFERENCES tenant.consents (id)
)


CREATE TABLE tenant.journal_lines (
	posting_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(posting_id) REFERENCES tenant.ledger_entries (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES tenant.locations (id)
)
